summary: Run budget is exhausted with no new evidence available, so the draft bytes stand unchanged (no duplicate revision). The investigation closed with a complete, self-consistent record: one asserted defect, twice witnessed through real producers and with its consequence measured and bounded - shouldSnapshot compares the log store's last index against the cached snapshot index as unsigned values, so a node whose store sits below its snapshot index reports that it should snapshot and makes redundant snapshot attempts at an unchanged index, while committed and applied state are correct and no safety effect is claimed; three suspicions refuted with retained operands (voter-only commit eligibility, durable last vote across restart, and the AddVoter configuration lag as a bounded replication transient); and four durable Behaviors/Facts, two corrected under their own ids once measurement showed the per-interval implication and the stored-count proxy were unsupported. Residual unknowns are recorded as limitations rather than resolved by assumption, chiefly the attempt-level cadence of the redundant snapshots and the store-specific artifact seen in the in-memory log store.
